```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(fpp3)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4
)
source("lab_submission.R")

lab_meta <- list(id = "lab02", title = "Stationarity and differencing")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "Expand (1-B)^2 y_t.",
  q2 = "A very slow ACF decay in levels usually means:",
  q3 = "For Beer, (1-B)(1-B^4) at 1993 Q2 (421, 433, 410, 443) equals:",
  q4 = "In one sentence, when do you stop differencing?"
)
```

## What you will do

Expand differences and decide when a series looks stationary enough to stop.

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `fpp3`, `learnr`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("y_t - 2 y_{t-1} + y_{t-2}", correct = TRUE),
  answer("y_t - y_{t-1}"),
  answer("y_t - y_{t-2}"),
  answer("y_t - y_{t-1} - y_{t-4}"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```
```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Suspect nonstationarity (or very strong persistence)", correct = TRUE),
  answer("The series is white noise"),
  answer("You must set D=2"),
  answer("The series is an MA(1)"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r beer-diff, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=10}
beer <- aus_production |>
  filter(!is.na(Beer), Quarter >= yearquarter("1992 Q1"),
         Quarter <= yearquarter("1993 Q4")) |>
  select(Quarter, Beer) |>
  mutate(d14 = difference(difference(Beer, lag = 4)))
beer
```

```{r q3}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  answer("21", correct = TRUE),
  answer("-21"),
  answer("443"),
  answer("0"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```
```{r q4}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q4"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "Plots and ACF look stationary; avoid a large negative lag-1 spike.",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}

  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),

      path = file,
```
